maria (docs): Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4902 - new Erebus-13b model card + catalog entry. Need quick reviews on variants, seq limits, and the SDK snippets.

sam (ml eng): on it. Quick: does Erebus use grouped-attn? affects recommended max.

maria (docs): yes grouped-attn; I added a 'recommended max (soft): 12k tokens' and note about degraded perf after 8k.

jen (devex): bench link anchor broken in the card (bench/erebus -> 404).

maria (docs): fixed to https://bench.redwood.ai/erebus-13b-v1. pulled Sasha's 3k-token throughput; infra confirm?

dave (infra): numbers match. please add CPU fallback (int8-cpu) and KV cache warmup note.

maria (docs): added both. also updated SDK snippet (streaming example) per devex suggestion.

ci-bot: GitHub / checks - docs-lint failed: anchor docs/modelcatalog.md#hardware-compat not found.

maria (docs): pushing toc fix and anchor redirect.

ci-bot: GitHub / checks - docs-lint passed on PR #4902.

maria (docs): merging after CI green. will follow up with micro-bench table in a follow-up PR. thanks all :tada:
